description: DataForB2B helps sales, recruiting, and GTM teams with sales prospecting, candidate sourcing, talent mapping, and B2B data enrichment. It finds leads and candidates, surfaces funding rounds and hiring signals, searches jobs and LinkedIn or other social posts, and retrieves available work emails and contact details to prepare outreach.
